Detailed Description

Contain the current channel selection which has chosen by the task.

From the channel and the bandwidth, a center channel can be evaluated by a look-up on 'son::wireless_utils::channels_table_5g'

Parameters
channelChosen beacon channel.
secondary_channelChosen secondary beacon channel. Relevant only if the bandwidth is 80+80.
bwBandwidth of the channel.
dfs_stateDFS state for knowing if the channel is DFS channel or not.
